preregistered_guidance_gate_note: A title can mention several companies; one title is not necessarily one event. No claim that this conservative row count proves a universal shortage of company events. The selected single-company non-summary event design requires enough independent eligible articles.
rules: Explicit title codes only; event keywords are screening, not sentiment or novelty labels; next trading signal day is provisional and does not cure incorrect publication dates.
limitations: Company-name and industry-only news not mapped by this conservative check.
URL dates are suspicious indicators, not verified publication times.
RAG retrieval selection and missing articles prevent exhaustive coverage claims.
No return labels, predictions, model fitting, portfolio simulation or 2026 data loaded.
decision: Complete bounded mechanism/source verification before any financial increment experiment; news benefit remains untested.
